prompt: Write 10 distinct notes the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual made about one member each while helping them with: energy bills squeezing the budget. Each says what will help the next time this agent serves this member: how they like to be dealt with, what is still open, what to check. One or two sentences, third person, no names. This batch leans towards self-employed members and small business owners. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 5)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"Member said energy bills have tightened the household budget, so they are keen to keep any repair costs within delegated authority and avoid unnecessary delays."},{"type":"preference","content":"They prefer clear, practical updates by phone and do not want long explanations unless there is a decision to make."},{"type":"fact","content":"They are self-employed and the timing of the claim matters because cash flow is uneven; any excess, VAT position and payment method should be checked carefully next time."},{"type":"observation","content":"They were cooperative but anxious about disruption, especially where a home repair could affect work from home arrangements and income."},{"type":"preference","content":"They liked being asked for documents in one go rather than in stages, as this helped them gather invoices, photos and bank details efficiently."},{"type":"fact","content":"Outstanding items include confirming the cause of damage, checking whether any temporary repair is still needed, and verifying if any part of the loss may fall outside cover."},{"type":"observation","content":"They asked for a quick steer on whether the claim is likely to stay within delegated authority, as they are trying to avoid extra hassle and cost."},{"type":"preference","content":"They responded well to a calm, businesslike approach and preferred the agent to focus on next steps rather than insurance jargon."},{"type":"fact","content":"As a small business owner, they may need to evidence any loss of earnings or extra working costs separately, so this should be checked before the file is moved on."},{"type":"observation","content":"They are worried about another increase in bills, so the next handler should check for any straightforward settlement route, confirm open questions, and keep contact efficient."}]}
